# Code of conduct

Be kind and be useful. This applies in issues, pull requests, reviews and anywhere else people talk about this project.

- Treat everyone with respect. No harassment, discrimination, personal attacks or unwelcome sexual attention.
- Assume good faith, disagree about the work and not the person, and take feedback calmly.
- Don't publish other people's private information, including member data.
- Stay on topic in issues and reviews.

Maintainers may edit or remove comments, close issues and block people who break these rules.

To report a problem, contact the repository owner privately through their GitHub profile. Reports are kept confidential and answered within a week.
